title: Tech Note: Object Storage in 4D v11 SQL Using Native Commands
author: Luis Pineiros Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: SET LIST ITEM PARAMETER / GET LIST ITEM PARAMETER commands

historical_commentary.text: This note captures 4D's early, native attempt at object-like storage on top of the classic hierarchical list structure — years before 4D introduced true JSON/object support (the Object type and OB commands) in later versions. The specific SET/GET LIST ITEM PARAMETER approach is now superseded by native object (OB Get/OB Set) and JSON support built directly into the language.
related_updates: 4D later added native Object (OB_...) and JSON commands, providing far more ergonomic key/value and nested-object storage than the hierarchical-list workaround shown here
ORDA (2018+) and native JSON support now handle most of what this technique was working around
